Graduate & Doctoral Admissions
Graduate & Doctoral Admissions
All students enrolled in our on-campus MS engineering degree programs will pay the resident graduate tuition. This offers a significant cost savings to our welcomed out-of-state and international MS graduate students.
Speed School offers three options for students to continue their education beyond a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Engineering.
Explore Our Advanced Degrees & Certificates
Master's Degree in Engineering (4+1 Program)
The quickest path to a Master’s degree in Engineering is through our 4+1 program. Each undergraduate Engineering discipline enables you to earn your MEng just three semesters after your Bachelor of Science degree at the University of Louisville. As an added bonus, your tuition rate remains the same, even as a graduate student!
This degree is only available to students who earn an undergraduate degree at the University of Louisville. If you’re an undergraduate student and are interested, fill and complete the Graduate Application.
Master of Engineering degrees are available in:
Bioengineering (Meng)
Chemical Engineering (MEng)
Civil Engineering (MEng)
Computer Science and Engineering (MEng)
Electrical Engineering (MEng)
Mechanical Engineering (MEng)
Master’s in Engineering in Engineering Management Online (MEEMO)
The Master’s in Engineering in Engineering Management online is designed for experienced engineers who want to develop superior skills in managing engineering projects, products and services. UofL’s online Engineering Management degree builds on your current knowledge and experience to expand the professional opportunities available to you. Gain the credentials and knowledge you need to take charge of complex engineering projects, play an active role in the development of your organization, move into leadership roles and increase your earnings.
As an online Engineering Management student, you will have the chance to learn more about this technique, complete a Six Sigma process improvement project and earn your black belt through the Industrial and Systems Engineers (IISE).
Master of Science (M.S.)
All students enrolled in our on-campus MS engineering degree programs will pay the resident graduate tuition. This offers a significant cost savings to our welcomed out-of-state and international MS graduate students.
If you completed or are about to complete an undergraduate degree from another college or university, or if you studied something other than Engineering as a UofL undergraduate, the Master of Science in Engineering is made for you.
Master of Science degrees are available in:
MS in Artificial Intelligence in Medicine
MS in Bioengineering
MS in Chemical Engineering
MS in Civil Engineering (Online Option)
MS in Computer Science (Online Option)
MS in Electrical Engineering (Online Option)
MS in Industrial & Systems Engineering (Online Option)
MS in Materials and Energy Science and Engineering (Online Option)
MS in Mechanical Engineering
The Master of Science programs require you to complete an online application through the Graduate School. Your application must also include a non-refundable $65 fee.
Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.)
Seven Areas of Study offer a Doctor of Philosophy in Engineering:
Bioengineering,
Chemical Engineering,
Civil Engineering,
Computer Science & Engineering,
Electrical Engineering,
Industrial & Systems Engineering, and
Mechanical Engineering.
The Ph.D. Programs require you to complete an online application through the Graduate School. Your application must also include a non-refundable $65 fee.
If you are a qualifying doctoral-level student, you may be awarded fellowships worth $22,000 per year, plus full tuition and health insurance. These funding sources can be renewed annually for up to four years.
International students must also demonstrate English proficiency by supplying official TOEFL or IELTS exam results. Click here for additional information on international student application requirements.
Graduate Certificates
In certain disciplines, certificates can be a great way to receive specialized training and advance your career goals. Some employers may even require certification, and all employers will value the extra skills and knowledge that you’ve gained.
Each certificate program has its own requirements. Select from the following:
Analytics for Engineering Decision Making
The graduate certificate in Analytics for Engineering Decision Making offers students training to address the growing need for analytics and data-driven decision making, at the regional and national level. The overall goal is to develop talent that is equipped with operational decision analytics skills, including both predictive and prescriptive skills. Students will be prepared to work for a wide range of organizations (businesses, non-profits, NGOs, etc.) in the U.S. Upon completion of the certificate, students will acquire core knowledge on data analytics in decision making and combines three sub-areas of Industrial Engineering (Data Analytics, Operations Research, and Decision Making).
This program is offered by the J.B. Speed School of Engineering at the University of Louisville, through the Industrial & Systems Engineering (ISE) department
More about Analytics for Engineering Decision Making
Artificial Intelligence in Medicine
The application of artificial intelligence to master the analysis of biomedical data takes the classic field of medicine and transforms it to better and more quickly interpret the vast amounts of data available to increase the discovery of new medicines and improved treatments for the human body.
This program is offered by the J.B. Speed School of Engineering at the University of Louisville, through the Bioengineering (BE) department, in conjunction with the Computer Science Engineering (CSE) department and the School of Public Health & Information Sciences.
More about Artificial Intelligence in Medicine
Cybersecurity
You’ve seen it on the news: increased threats and attacks on our digital infrastructure. Some of the most sought-after professionals are the reverse hackers who can monitor, identify, and neutralize cybercrime.
The Department of Computer Engineering and Computer Science offers this certificate program, which can be completed in the classroom or 100% online. 12 credit hours are required for completion.
More About Cybersecurity
Data Science
These days, most corporations understand that data rules. With that in mind, every organization needs an expert (or experts) to leverage data for new business, cost efficiency, and risk avoidance.
The Department of Computer Engineering and Computer Science offers this certificate program, which can be completed in the classroom or 100% online. 18 credit hours are required for completion.
More About Data Science
Engineering Logistics
Leverage the knowledge learned from the Graduate Certificate in Engineering Logistics and help organizations research and analyze various models of logistics systems, anticipate and meet customer needs, optimize supply chain performance and help support the company’s overall productivity and bottom line.
This online Graduate Certificate in Engineering Logistics is offered through the J.B. School of Engineering.
More About Engineering Logistics
Healthcare Systems Engineering
The online graduate certificate in Healthcare Systems Engineering is designed to provide students with the technical skills, methodologies, and analytical tools needed to specialize in systems analysis, predictive modeling, patient safety, and information technology within the healthcare system.
This online graduate certificate in healthcare systems engineering is offered through the J. B. Speed School of Engineering at the University of Louisville.
More about Healthcare Systems Engineering
Six Sigma
UofL’s graduate certificate in Six Sigma provides students with techniques and knowledge in mission-critical business areas such as: cutting costs, increasing revenue and productivity, as well as overall strategies for improvement of processes. Graduates will be ready to complete the Six Sigma Black Belt examination through the Institute of Industrial & Systems Engineers (IISE).
The online Graduate Certificate in Six Sigma is designed for professionals who are ready to advance their potential as industry leaders through industry-proven techniques and expertise in process improvement.
More about Six Sigma
Structural Engineering
Even if you have a background in civil engineering, you may need additional training focused on structural engineering. Speed School makes it easy with this certificate that can be earned alongside the Master of Science in Civil Engineering (M.S.).
The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering offers this certificate program, which can be completed in the classroom or 100% online. 12 credit hours are required for completion.
More About Structural Engineering
Transportation Engineering
Engineers know that a sustainable and resilient infrastructure is vital to our future. In the U.S., a skilled workforce that can solve our transportation challenges will be in demand — and well-compensated.
The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering offers this certificate program, which can be completed in the classroom or 100% online. 12 credit hours are required for completion.
More About Transportation Engineering
Interested in our Graduate Programs but Have Questions?
Complete the Interest Form and a team member from our Graduate Affairs department will contact you to make sure you have all the answers to make an informed decision before enrolling.
Complete the Interest Form
Military-Connected Students
UofL is a military-friendly school that recognizes the unique challenges and circumstances faced by members of the armed forces and strives to provide the support and flexibility you need to succeed as a college student. No matter where you are in your military career—or wherever you are in the world—we bring our classroom directly to you, helping you realize your potential and accomplish your goals.
Learn more about the Center for Military-Connected Students.
​International Students
In addition to the general Application Requirements, international applicants must also provide the following:
Proof of Language Proficiency (Review Accepted Exams)
International Credential Review (Review the Credential Evaluation Process)

Student Testimonials
Ayodeji Adeniran
Mechanical Engineering PhD Student from Nigeria
“My advice to future International students would be to do your research when planning to come abroad. I was intentional about choosing an urban location for my PhD which was one of the determining factors for me attending UofL.”
Shruti Kumar
Industrial Engineering PhD Student from India
“My research basically involves controls. Industry is all about automation these days, so automation requires a lot of controls. It can be applied to any industry you want…They know what is going on in the global market, they understand new trends, and accordingly they keep up to date.”
Tomas Llano-Rios
Computer Science PhD Student from Colombia
“I like the diversity I have,” Llano-Rios said. “With the people at Speed IT, I’ve been able to harness more of my abilities for working on a problem. With my research I’ve been able to harness my knowledge of programming in a more performative way.”
Mahmud Parvez
Industrial Engineering PhD Student from Bangladesh
“At my previous institution, I often encountered challenges and barriers as an international student, which made the experience quite overwhelming. However, my experience at the University of Louisville has been completely different. I am grateful for #UofL’s commitment to creating a supportive and inclusive space for international students like myself, where we can thrive academically and personally.”
Sumit Paul
Industrial Engineering PhD Student from Bangladesh
“As an international student I have had the opportunity to be a part of the diverse community at #UofL.” He credits his advisor Dr. Li Yang for giving him opportunities to grow as a scholar and encourages future international students to communicate regularly with their advisors. “They are your guides.”
Shumaker Research Building
No matter what Area of Study you pursue, you'll have access to world-class instructors and cutting-edge facilities — including the Shumaker Research Building.
